name: k8s-cronjob-mcp
description: Read-only Kubernetes CronJob monitoring and failure triage.
long_description: Inspect CronJob health, schedules, run history, active runs, and synthesized failure causes through a read-only MCP server. Requires a kubeconfig with permission to read CronJobs, Jobs, Pods, Pod logs, and Events.

kubeconfig.title: Kubeconfig file
kubeconfig.description: Choose the kubeconfig Claude Desktop should use.

context.title: Kubernetes context
context.description: Pin the context name from `kubectl config get-contexts` to avoid following a changing current-context.

allowed_namespaces.title: Allowed namespaces
allowed_namespaces.description: Optional comma-separated namespace allowlist, for example batch,reports.

default_timezone.title: Default schedule timezone
default_timezone.description: IANA timezone for CronJobs without spec.timeZone. Usually UTC.
